g.text: Tombstones (deleted=true) hide removed cars and reject stale events.
Nested numeric types follow the JSON snapshot; price is Decimal128.
Product View is the sole MongoDB owner.
Synchronizer accesses the projection only through the internal API.
Keycloak owns and migrates its identity schema.
Business services do not read these tables.
Protected customerGuid attributes reference Users UUIDs logically.
Self-registration uses stable issuer/subject linkage, not email matching.
Internal Keycloak tables are outside the domain model shown here.
PK = primary key, FK = local foreign key, UQ = unique constraint
Dashed dependencies across databases are logical UUID references, never SQL FKs.
SQL timestamps follow the current JPA mappings; no field is added by this diagram.
Outbox/inbox and active workers exist in every SQL-owning service.
